name: source_weierstrass_extended

definitions_used.IsMinOn: ∀ z, z ∈ V → f p ≤ f z; p membership separate
definitions_used.LowerSemicontinuous: global lower semicontinuity in given topology and EReal order topology

expanded_domain_assumption: ∃ x : X, x ∈ V ∧ f x < ⊤
literal_conclusion: ∃ p ∈ V, IsMinOn f V p
expanded_conclusion: ∃ p : X, p ∈ V ∧ ∀ z : X, z ∈ V → f p ≤ f z
arithmetic: EReal order only; no toReal, norm, sum or division
consequences: minimizer value < top and thus minimizer in effectiveDomain

edge_cases.bottom: allowed globally and as the attained minimum; domain witness may have bottom value
edge_cases.finite_witness: not required: less than top need not be a finite embedded real
edge_cases.top: permitted at some feasible points; identically top on V excluded by hdom
edge_cases.outside_V: not minimized over; values constrained by global lower semicontinuity only

ambiguities: Internal implementation of lower semicontinuity not inspected; supplied semantic definition used
